00432       SUBROUTINE TRINWT                          !  RECTANGLE.AAMAIN
00433 c     =================  
00434 c                                                                       
00435 c-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
00436 c                                                                       
00437 c     Decides whether the point yr,yz is inside the curved side
00438 c     triangle pnodr(*),pnodz(*).
00439 c
00440 c     Input quantities:  yr,yz,pnodr(*),pnodz(*).
00441 c     Output quantities: kerror, csi,eta.
00442 c
00443 c     If the point is inside:  kerror=-1, otherwise kerror=+1.
00444 c                                                                       
00445 c-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
00446 c                                                                       
00447 #include "pt2dg.inc"                                              
00448 c                                                                
00449 c-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
00450 c
00451 c
00452             ztol       = 1.e-05
00453             kerror     = 1
00454             zr3        = pnodr(3)
00455             zr1c       = -pnodr(1) - 3.e00*pnodr(3) + 4.e00*pnodr(5)
00456             zr1e       = -pnodr(2) - 3.e00*pnodr(3) + 4.e00*pnodr(4)
00457             zr2c       = 2.e00*(pnodr(1)+pnodr(3))  - 4.e00*pnodr(5)
00458             zrce       = 4.e00*(pnodr(3)-pnodr(4)-pnodr(5)+pnodr(6))
00459             zr2e       = 2.e00*(pnodr(2)+pnodr(3))  - 4.e00*pnodr(4)
00460             zz3        = pnodz(3)
00461             zz1c       = -pnodz(1) - 3.e00*pnodz(3) + 4.e00*pnodz(5)
00462             zz1e       = -pnodz(2) - 3.e00*pnodz(3) + 4.e00*pnodz(4)
00463             zz2c       = 2.e00*(pnodz(1)+pnodz(3))  - 4.e00*pnodz(5)
00464             zzce       = 4.e00*(pnodz(3)-pnodz(4)-pnodz(5)+pnodz(6))
00465             zz2e       = 2.e00*(pnodz(2)+pnodz(3))  - 4.e00*pnodz(4)
00466             csi        = 0.33333e00   
00467             eta        = 0.33333e00  
00468       do 100       j10 = 1,100
00469             zfr        = -yrp + zr3 + zr1c*csi + zr1e*eta           +
00470      +                   zr2c*csi*csi + zrce*csi*eta + zr2e*eta*eta 
00471             zfz        = -yzp + zz3 + zz1c*csi + zz1e*eta           +
00472      +                   zz2c*csi*csi + zzce*csi*eta + zz2e*eta*eta 
00473             zdfrc      = zr1c + 2.e00*zr2c*csi + zrce*eta
00474             zdfre      = zr1e + zrce*csi + 2.e00*zr2e*eta   
00475             zdfzc      = zz1c + 2.e00*zz2c*csi + zzce*eta
00476             zdfze      = zz1e + zzce*csi + 2.e00*zz2e*eta  
00477             zdelta     = zdfrc*zdfze - zdfre*zdfzc
00478             zdcsi      = (zfz*zdfre - zfr*zdfze)/zdelta     
00479             zdeta      = (zfr*zdfzc - zfz*zdfrc)/zdelta   
00480             ztest      = sqrt(zdcsi*zdcsi + zdeta*zdeta + 1.e-36)  
00481                          if(ztest.le.ztol) then
00482                          go to 99
00483                                            endif
00484             csi       = csi + zdcsi
00485             eta       = eta + zdeta
00486   100 continue
00487 c     ++++++
00488       RETURN
00489 c     ++++++
00490    99                   continue      
00491             csieta    = csi + eta
00492                         if(-1.e-03.le.csi.     and.
00493      +                     csi.le.1.001e00.    and.   
00494      +                     -1.e-03.le.eta.     and.
00495      +                     eta.le.1.001e00.    and.
00496      +                     -1.e-03.le.csieta.  and.
00497      +                     csieta.le.1.001e00         ) then
00498             zp3        = psiele(3)
00499             zp1c       = -psiele(1) - 3.e00*psiele(3) + 4.e00*psiele(5)
00500             zp1e       = -psiele(2) - 3.e00*psiele(3) + 4.e00*psiele(4)
00501             zp2c       = 2.e00*(psiele(1)+psiele(3))  - 4.e00*psiele(5)
00502             zpce       = 4.e00*(psiele(3)-psiele(4)-psiele(5)+psiele(6))
00503             zp2e       = 2.e00*(psiele(2)+psiele(3))  - 4.e00*psiele(4)
00504             ypsi       = zp3 + zp1c*csi + zp1e*eta                  +
00505      +                   zp2c*csi*csi + zpce*csi*eta + zp2e*eta*eta 
00506             kerror     = -1   
00507                                                         endif
00508 c                                                                       
00509 c-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
00510 c                                                                       
00511       RETURN                                                            
00512       END                                                               
00513       SUBROUTINE BPOLRZ                          !  RECTANGLE.AAMAIN
00514 c     =================  
00515 c                                                                       
00516 c-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
00517 c                                                                       
00518 c     Computes the two (-R- & -Z-) components of Bpoloidal.
00519 c
00520 c     Input quantities:  csi,eta,yrp,yzp,pnodr(*),pnodz(*),psiele(*)
00521 c     Output quantities: ybpolr, ybpolz
00522 c                                                                       
00523 c-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
00524 c                                                                       
00525 #include "pt2dg.inc"                                              
00526 c
00527       dimension          zf(6),          zd(2,6),        zjac(2,2)
00528 c                                                                
00529 c-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
00530 c
00531 c
00532       do 100        j1 = 1,6
00533                 zf(j1) = 0.e00                                          
00534               zd(1,j1) = 0.e00                                          
00535               zd(2,j1) = 0.e00                                          
00536   100 continue 
00537 c
00538 c                                                         
00539             zl1        = csi 
00540             zl2        = eta  
00541             zl3        = 1.e00 - zl1 - zl2  
00542             zf(1)      = zl1*(2.e00*zl1-1.e00) 
00543             zf(2)      = zl2*(2.e00*zl2-1.e00)  
00544             zf(3)      = zl3*(2.e00*zl3-1.e00) 
00545             zf(4)      = 4.e00*zl2*zl3          
00546             zf(5)      = 4.e00*zl3*zl1         
00547             zf(6)      = 4.e00*zl1*zl2        
00548             zd(1,1)    = 4.e00*zl1 - 1.e00       
00549             zd(2,2)    = 4.e00*zl2 - 1.e00      
00550             zd(1,3)    = -(4.e00*zl3 - 1.e00)    
00551             zd(2,3)    = -(4.e00*zl3 - 1.e00)   
00552             zd(1,4)    = -4.e00*zl2              
00553             zd(2,4)    = 4.e00*(zl3 - zl2)     
00554             zd(1,5)    = 4.e00*(zl3 - zl1)    
00555             zd(2,5)    = -4.e00*zl1           
00556             zd(1,6)    = 4.e00*zl2            
00557             zd(2,6)    = 4.e00*zl1           
00558 c
00559 c
00560             zrx1       = 4.e00*pnodr(5)-3.e00*pnodr(3)-pnodr(1)      
00561             zrx2       = 2.e00*(pnodr(1)+pnodr(3)-2.e00*pnodr(5))    
00562             zrxy       = 4.e00*(pnodr(3)+pnodr(6)-                    
00563      +                          pnodr(4)-pnodr(5))  
00564             zjac(1,1)  = zrx1 + 2.e00*zrx2*csi + zrxy*eta  
00565 c                
00566             zry1       = 4.e00*pnodr(4)-3.e00*pnodr(3)-pnodr(2)      
00567             zry2       = 2.e00*(pnodr(2)+pnodr(3)-2.e00*pnodr(4))    
00568             zjac(1,2)  = zry1 + zrxy*csi + 2.e00*zry2*eta
00569 c
00570             zzx1       = 4.e00*pnodz(5)-3.e00*pnodz(3)-pnodz(1)      
00571             zzx2       = 2.e00*(pnodz(1)+pnodz(3)-2.e00*pnodz(5))    
00572             zzxy       = 4.e00*(pnodz(3)+pnodz(6)-                    
00573      +                          pnodz(4)-pnodz(5))  
00574             zjac(2,1)  = zzx1 + 2.e00*zzx2*csi + zzxy*eta    
00575 c              
00576             zzy1       = 4.e00*pnodz(4)-3.e00*pnodz(3)-pnodz(2)      
00577             zzy2       = 2.e00*(pnodz(2)+pnodz(3)-2.e00*pnodz(4))    
00578             zjac(2,2)  = zzy1 + zzxy*csi + 2.e00*zzy2*eta
00579 c
00580             zjdet      = zjac(1,1)*zjac(2,2) - zjac(2,1)*zjac(1,2)
00581 c
00582 c
00583             zpsir      = 0.e00
00584             zpsiz      = 0.e00
00585       do 200        j2 = 1,6
00586             zpsir      = zpsir + psiele(j2)*
00587      +                         (zjac(2,1)*zd(1,j2)-zjac(2,2)*zd(2,j2))
00588             zpsiz      = zpsiz - psiele(j2)*
00589      +                         (zjac(1,1)*zd(1,j2)-zjac(1,2)*zd(2,j2))
00590   200 continue   
00591             zpsir      = zpsir/zjdet 
00592             zpsiz      = zpsiz/zjdet
00593 c
00594 c
00595             ybpolr     = zpsiz/yrp 
00596             ybpolz     =-zpsir/yrp 
00597 c                                                                       
00598 c                                                                       
00599 c-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
00600 c                                                                       
00601       RETURN                                                            
00602       END

00638       subroutine wreqdg(lun,ngpr,ngpz,iret, nr,nz, psib,
00639      ,                                             btf,rtf,rgr,zgr,pfm)
00640 c=====================================================
00641 c*** Write the equilibrium data in the dg-compatible format.
00642 c***
00643 c*** Input:

00645 c***  ngpr    the maximum number of points in R direction
00646 c***  nr      the actual number of points in R direction

00649 c***  btf     the toroidal magnetic field at the R=rtf

00653 c***
00654 c*** Output:

00656 c=====================================================
00657 c
00658 c  version : 23.06.97 17:23
00659 c
00660       implicit none
